Then & now.

↔

Every product starts somewhere.

The original MUN Helper: motions, conferences, and notes in one simple workspace.

The build story.

The first dashboard

MUN Helper put motions, conferences, and notes one click from the home screen. Before you added a conference, most of that screen was empty.

A place for the delegate

In the newer dashboard, the conference card carries the country, committee, and date together. Open the workspace from the card and you already know which assignment you’re working on.

Preparing by date

The month view brings the conference date into the dashboard. A delegate can check what’s coming up alongside the preparation workspace.
